archive_scope: Plain snapshots, logs, status records, probes, scripts as inert evidence, and the receipt; no overlay, binary objects, or execution of archived scripts. Result records retain historical paths and object hashes, not the objects themselves.
coverage: Affected prerequisites freshly rebuilt in isolated overlay; other dependencies including mathlib reused precompiled objects; not a full project build.
description: AffineBudget.compose replaces repeated affine-budget proof arguments; the helper is a new public imported module.
failed_exact_packet: Helper succeeded; target failed with three No goals to be solved errors caused by trailing omega tactics. The three dead tactics were removed before the successful replay. The failure log and two result records are retained separately.
failed_initial_client: The initial depth client failed after prerequisites were compiled without the package root, changing private names. Its log and all initial result records are preserved under evidence/first-run/. All 28 prerequisites were then rebuilt with the correct -R package root and the entire baseline and final replay succeeded.
